# Python dependencies for the NaC execution environment.
# Every package is pinned with ==. Bump deliberately, rebuild, and re-tag the image.
# The fully resolved lock (including transitive deps) is written to /opt/ee-manifest/pip-freeze.txt
# inside the image at build time - diff that between releases.
